dcat_keyword_sm: Osoyoos Division of Yale Land District
dct_creator_sm: Skinner, Ernest Meeson (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
Jemmett, William Sugden (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Penticton Band reserves Penticton 1, Penticton 2 and Penticton 3A in the area around Okanagan Lake and Dog Lake from the Narron River in the south to Trout River in the North. Land cover and features described on the map includes villages, gardens, fields, trails to Keremeus and Osoyoos, a shale pit, roads, Marama Creek, Marran Lake, Snake Creek, cultivated areas, and the types and land, soil, and timber.
